{{Quote|How you feeling?"<br />"Oh, terrific. Why don't we go outside and get some calisthenics in before it gets too dark?"<br />"Sure. We can always play some tag.|Han Solo and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="ESBr">{{ESBRadio|A Question of Survival}}</ref>}}
'''Tag''' was a [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]]' playground game in which the player who was "it" chased the other players, trying to touch one of them, thereby making that individual "it" in his or her stead. That game was popular in the [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|Slave Quarters Row]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="E1VG">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref> While holed up in an emergency shelter during one of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] brutal nights, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] joked with a physically injured and weakened [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] that they could go out into the Hoth blizzard and play tag.<ref name="ESBr" />
